canDoYue: 你識報廚房漏水，講聽日六點之後外出，同埋鎖匙放喺前門保安。
canDoEn: Report a kitchen leak, say you are out after six tomorrow, and leave the key with the front guard.

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: Hello there, the kitchen tap has a small leak, and water has been on the floor since yesterday.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，廚房水龍頭有少少漏水，由尋日開始地下有水。
dialogue.say: Hello there, the kitchen tap has a small leak, and water has been on the floor since yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: I am sorry about the leak. When did the tap start, and is the water still running?
dialogue.glossYue: 唔好意思。水龍頭幾時開始漏，而家仲流緊水呀？
dialogue.say: I am sorry about the leak. When did the tap start, and is the water still running?

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: The kitchen leak started yesterday morning, and it is much worse, so I need one quick repair.
dialogue.glossYue: 廚房尋日朝早開始漏，而家嚴重好多，我要一次快啲嘅維修。
dialogue.say: The kitchen leak started yesterday morning, and it is much worse, so I need one quick repair.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: A repair visit can come tomorrow after six in the evening. Will you be out of the flat then?
dialogue.glossYue: 維修可以聽日傍晚六點之後嚟。嗰陣你會唔會唔喺單位？
dialogue.say: A repair visit can come tomorrow after six in the evening. Will you be out of the flat then?

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: I will be out after six tomorrow, so please take the key from the front guard then.
dialogue.glossYue: 我聽日六點之後會外出，請向前門保安攞鎖匙。
dialogue.say: I will be out after six tomorrow, so please take the key from the front guard then.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: Can the team have access to the flat while you are out after six tomorrow evening?
dialogue.glossYue: 你聽日傍晚六點之後外出，同事可唔可以入單位？
dialogue.say: Can the team have access to the flat while you are out after six tomorrow evening?

dialogue.speaker: nell
dialogue.text: Yes, the front guard can give you access, and the flat key stays at the front desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，前門保安可以畀你入單位，鎖匙放喺前台。
dialogue.say: Yes, the front guard can give you access, and the flat key stays at the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: glen
dialogue.text: We will send one person for the kitchen tap leak, and the repair starts after six tomorrow.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋會派一個人處理廚房水龍頭漏水，維修聽日六點之後開始。
dialogue.say: We will send one person for the kitchen tap leak, and the repair starts after six tomorrow.
